string.text: How's it going, Viktor? Have you had anything to eat?
Six of them against just the two of us, and we wiped the floor with them...
How are you doing, Viktor? Did you manage to find people for the trip?
Hey, my friend. Looks like we've got enough people to put together a solid team now... A former Mercenary, a former Duty member, a former Clear Sky, a Scientist, and you... a former thief? Haha.
I haven't eaten anything...
Here, buddy, take this. Don't go around looking so miserable, hahaha. Next time, just tell me and I'll share some food with you.
Thanks, Viper.
So, you're finally awake, stalker. Come on, lets talk for a bit.
Hey... You were in the truck with me, right?
That's right. I came to see you because you looked a bit too young for a place like this. I'm guessing this is your first time here, isn't it?
Yeah, it's my first time here. I didn't really have anywhere else to go. I got caught stealing a few times, so it was either this or prison.
I see... Did you come prepared? The Zone shows no mercy to the unprepared. Weapons, meds... at least a flashlight?
No. I spent everything just to get a ride in on that truck.

Hmm... You're pretty green, friend. Let's do something: take this gear, suit up, and come with me. We'll take a little walk, and I'll show you how things work around here. After that, you can decide if this life's for you or not. Sounds fair? I was young once too, could've used a hand like this.
That's a lot of gear... Are you sure you don't need it? I can't pay you right now.

Don't worry about it. Someone helped me once, and when I tried to pay him back, he told me to pass it on to another newbie who needed it... Now get ready, we're moving. Check your gear on the way, and try not to wander off... you might get lost.
Alright. I'll follow you. Thanks a lot.
(Task) That was quite a walk.
You said it, friend. Six of them against the two of us, and they still didn't stand a chance... By the way, you all good? Here, just in case.
Thanks, I appreciate it. By the way, I'm looking for a grave... It's shaped like a cross, with a gas mask hanging from it. Do you know where I should start looking?

There are plenty like that scattered around the Zone. When a stalker dies, his friends usually hang his mask on a cross as a tribute... Before I left the Zone, there were a few like that in the rookies camp, not sure if they're still there now. You'll have to ask around. Talk to the stalkers or the trader, name's Sidorovich. Though I wouldn't recommend dealing with him unless you have to. That fat bastard won't lift a finger without getting something out of it...
I see. Then I'll ask around first... Anyway, are you heading back to base?

Yeah, I was just about to. We can head back together if you want, but first, take this as a reward. Found it in the truck behind us, and who knows what kind of deals those bandits were running with it.
And what am I supposed to do with this? It's locked.

There's a guy around here who does business with high-end gear directly, goes by Nimble. I figured there might be a weapon or something valuable inside, so I passed along your contact. He'll probably reach out to you to make a deal.
Got it. Thanks, I'll try to get in touch with him soon.
No problem. Come find me later if you've got more questions or need anything. Good hunting, stalker.
Good hunting, Viper.
(Task) Hey Viper, I found the grave I was looking for, and now I've got even more questions.
Hey, friend. What kind of questions?
Turns out someone got there before me and took the stash that was supposed to be mine.
Your stash? But, weren't you new to the Zone?
Yeah, but I came here with information about it.

Look, what happened to you was a usual day here. If a stalker finds a stash, they keep it. Not much you can do about it, friend. What I do recommend is to investigate, and if you find information about the guy, let me know so I can go with you. Sounds good? You can count on me.
Alright. I'll let you know when I find something.
(Interaction) I found this PDA on some crazy guy who shot at me, near the cross I was looking for.
Let me see... A Monolith soldier in Cordon? This is dangerous, they don't usually come this far south.
Monolith? What's that?

It's... complicated. They're like fanatical cultists who worship the "Monolith", supposedly some kind of rock at the center of the Zone that grants wishes. But they guard the center, so no one can get close. Most of what we know is just rumors... Except for one thing.
What's that?
They're extremely dangerous. No fear of death. If they have to kill themselves to complete their mission, they will. So watch yourself... I wouldn't recommend getting involved with them.
I see. Well, thanks for the info.
(Task) I found some information about what I was looking for. (Explain what you've talked with Sidorovich)
So this guy, Atreo, was after the same thing as you. We'll probably run into a few bodies along the way... Where exactly do those coordinates lead?
To some ruins in the Great Swamps. Do you know the place? Can you guide me there?

Let me see those coordinates... (Viper checks your PDA) Yeah, I know this place like the back of my hand. \n I've got two bits of news for you: the bad news is that the shortcut isn't a great option right now, cause it would lead to a fight against the military and we're not ready for that. The good news is that I know another route along the railway tracks. But, it'll take longer, so stock up on supplies first and then come see me when you're ready.
Alright. I'll be back when I'm ready.
(Task) I'm ready to go.
Not forgetting anything? We might be out all day. Make sure you have water.
Yeah, I'm ready. Let's go.
Wait, I forgot something. I'll be back.
Let's wait for nightfall and then we move. Ok?
Sure. I'll stick around and wait with you.
(Task) What happened? How did I get here?
You don't remember anything? I went out on a job and found you lying in a nearby camp. You were unconscious so I dragged you here. There was a blind dog sniffing you, ready to tear you apart...
Damn that coward Atreo...

So you got mixed up with him, huh? I had a feeling that wouldn't end well. But hey, I've got some info. A while back, a chatter on the stalker network mentioned someone running desperately towards the tunnel that's east of the vehicle station. A stalker in a yellow jacket, covered in blood. Does it sound like your guy?
Yeah, that's him. He's been going by "Vovan" so no one could catch him.

Doesn't surprise me. Not the first time he's pulled something like that to scam people. I've heard he's used names like Leto, too... Be more careful, friend. You heading after him now? If you wait a few hours, I'll come with you, just need to finish something with Nimble first.
I can't wait, I'm going after him now.
Alright. I just hope he didn't head east, he'll be harder to track if he did. Come find me if you need anything else, friend.
Yeah. And thanks for saving me, I owe you one. See you around.
Hey, you don't look so good. Are you in one piece? Here, just in case...
(Explain what happened with the dead stalkers, the zombie, and the PDA)

Shit... I knew it. Atreo's been in something strange. Good thing you didn't go after him alone, seems like he's dangerous now. Also, I've got indo from Sidorovich: he says Darkscape, that forest east of Cordon where Atreo ran off to, is crawling with Monolith for some reason that we're still trying to figure out.
I need to find him and fast.

Yeah... I get it. Look, I need to find Atreo too, for my own reasons. But going solo is fucked up. We should put together a team, better protected that way. You've already seen how messed up Atreo is and how vicious the Monolith can be. We'll need to find some reliable stalkers to join us... And while you're at it, get yourself better gear, running around in a leather jacket with a pea shooter isn't exactly smart.
And who do I bring in?

Not sure. Talk to people who owe you a favor, or those who trust you, and send them my way. For now, I'm gonna hold that tunnel in case Atreo, or Leto, or Vovan, or whatever name he's using now, decides to come back... Once you've got people ready, send them to back me up. I've got a feeling we'll get unwanted visitors from that side of Cordon...
Why do you think that?
Just a gut feeling for now. I'll tell you more once I know for sure. Anyway, I've got to move, I'll be covering that spot. Come find me if you need anything. (Viper seems in a hurry)
Alright. I'll later send people your way.
(Interaction) I found this photo. Know anything about it?

Huh, didn't expect to see this again. Those are two old friends. The picture was taken by a third, also a friend of mine. He always carried around this old polaroid, snapping photos nonstop... Where did you find it?
In the tunnel to the south. I think it leads to the swamps.
I see. Brings back memories...
Who are they?

Mark and Ivan. We used to be in the same faction years ago, before everything went to hell. The photo was taken by Hook, a real friendly stalker we could never quite kick out of our hideout. Somehow, the bastard always showed up whenever he felt like it. Those were different times in the Zone.
I get it. Well, you can keep the photo.
Thanks, friend. Here, for your trouble. And thanks for bringing back the memory... The life we had back then in the Zone it's gone. Too much has happened.
I understand... See you around.
(Interaction) What do you think of Rooster?

Good guy, he saved a friend of mine once. Wouldn't surprise me if some people called him eccentric, but I don't care about that. He's a solid shooter, knows his way around medicine, and he's very sharp. \n Stalkers who know little about the Zone would say he's careless or too relaxed... but if he's that calm, it's because he is certain that he can be. You get me? Otherwise, the Zone would've swallowed him a long time ago.
Huh... interesting take. I thought he seemed a bit distracted.
Don't let your guard down, friend. The ones who don't look like much usually survive for a reason. Always remember that.
That's good advice. Thanks.
(Interaction) What do you think about Rookie?

I don't like Duty, they come off fake to me; but this kid is stepping away from them to find his own place in the Zone, and that gives me a good feeling. Someone who learns through experience and follows his own ideals earns my respect. I just hope he doesn't run when things get ugly. He still looks pretty green.
I hope so too.
(Interaction) What do you think of Doggo?

I don't trust him. Did you know he used to be a mercenary? But well, he keeps talking about how good of a stalker you are, so I guess he trusts you and won't cause trouble... Although he never misses a chance to joke about how he should be leading the group.
I don't think he'll be a problem. All bark, no bite.
There's a reason they call him Doggo, dude.
...Damn. Didn't think of that. I take it back.
(Task) Look what I managed to recover. (Show Viper's suit)

Well, damn! I didn't expect to see this beauty again. I'm guessing you got it straight from Atreo, so I appreciate it. I don't have anything on me to pay you with right now, though. Please, take one of these flashlights. The headlamp's weaker, but it leaves your hands free. Your choice.
I'll take the handheld flashlight.
I'll take the headlamp.
Hope it serves you well.
Thanks a lot, friend. Though I've got one question. How did Atreo end up with that suit?

The bastard came to me before I left the Zone, desperate for work. I hired him to deliver this suit to someone that was buying it from me, simple job. It was just carrying the briefcase from Agroprom to Dark Valley. Later he told me he got jumped, beaten, and robbed, and I believed him. Then I found out he'd been trying to sell the suit himself. Luckily, nobody ever bought it, this thing's worth a fortune. I'm glad to have it back. It'll come in handy during our expedition.
I see.
(Task) Do you think we're ready to leave?

I still have a few things to sort out. I want to go over tactics with everyone and make sure we've got proper protection, good weapons and enough supplies. We don't know what's waiting for us out there, and Atreo seems to have an advantage over ordinary stalkers. \n Also, I've got a contact in Darkscape that's keeping an eye on the route ahead. I'm coordinating with him in case Atreo goes through.
Alright. I'll see if I have to fix something.
(Task) Do you think we're ready to leave?

Let me think: we've got the supplies, both Rookie's suit and mine are repaired... Doggo checked everyone's gear and gave us ammo. Rooster brought medicine and some food... Yeah, looks like everything's in order, friend. What about you? Got any unfinished business in Cordon? Because we might not be coming back for a good while.
Yeah. I'm ready.
I think I still have some things to do...
Alright. Give me a minute to change and tell the others to gear up. My contact says they're already in position, so if we have any trouble, we've got backup.
Alright, do your stuff then we move out. We'll hold the position while you're gone.
Okay, let's go.
Alright. I'll be back later.
(Interaction) What are you guarding here?

Son, if you're staying in the base, keep your head down, alright? We're under constant attacks from the Monolith because Freedom failed to hold the barrier. If you've got more questions, ask the captain, but don't bother him too much. We don't need any more stress.
I see, I won't stay long...
(Task) Hey, I'm looking for a grave shaped like a cross, with a gas mask hanging from it. Got any idea where I can find one?
You're not planning to loot some dead stalker's grave, are you?
(Lie) Not at all. I just wanted to pay my respects to someone...
(Tell the truth) I need to see what's there...

Strange, you're not the first one asking about that. Someone else asked the same thing a few weeks ago... Anyway, there are lots of graves around Cordon, you'll have to search yourself. I know there's one between the vehicle station and the railway tracks. Check there.
Show a little respect for the dead next time. Get out of my sight.
Thanks a lot, Wolf.
Hey, stalker. What do you need?
Get lost. I don't even want to look at you.
(Task) Hey Wolf, sorry to bother you. I'm looking for a stalker nicknamed "Atreo." Do you know him?
I guess you didn't get the message, you are bothering me. I'm not talking to some grave-robbing liar.
Alright... sorry.
(Task) Hey Wolf, I'm looking for a stalker nicknamed "Atreo." Do you know him?

Hmm, yeah, I know him. No clue where he is though. I know he picked on a lot of people around camp. Mage wanted to shoot him not long ago, sounds like he really crossed the line... Ask the others around here, they probably know more than I do.
Alright, thanks. See you around.
Kid, someone told me that a thief was coming, and I just so happen to need one. Are you him?
Hmm... let's just say that's me, yeah.
Relax, this is the Zone. Out here, thieves thrive while honest men babysit newbies...

...I'm joking, kid. You'll get used to it eventually. \n Anyway, about the job. There's a bastard whos going around robbing local stashes, and we've been trying to catch him for a while now. The other day I followed him, and found out he's been selling our gear to bandits, which means that I owe him a lesson. I know he hides the loot on the roof of some ruins farther north, past the railway tracks. I can mark it on your PDA. So, how about robbing a thief? I'll try tracking him in the meantime until I finally corner him. Bring back the explosives he stole from me, and I'll pay you well. You can keep whatever else you find up there while you are at it. Do we have a deal?
This job's perfect for me. Deal.
I'll pass.
Great. Be careful, bandits are known to hang around that place.
I will. See you around.
(Task) I brought what you asked for.
Perfect. Don't tell anyone about this. So, how'd it go?
Some bandits spotted me...

Damn. Well, if you made it back in one piece, I'd say it went alright. Here, take this. Thanks for the trouble. Stay out of the way for now, I've got people tracking that scumbag down. If we find him, he's gonna get fucked.
Sure, count me in. See you around.
(Task) Hey. I got your message, came as soon as I could.

Great, glad you made it. We tracked down the thief, and turns out it's "Andrés Mage", a stalker who's spent years in the Zone pretending to be a decent guy. Looks like he invested all the money from the robberies because he's heavily armed now. He was last seen around the eastern railway tracks. If you deal with him without problems, bring me his PDA, I'm interested in it.
Isn't it too dangerous to face a heavily armed veteran by myself?
Yeah, but two of my boys are coming with you, don't worry. Just watch each other's backs out there. They were already on their way here, so wait for them.
Alright. I'll wait.
(Task) We took care of him, and I brought his PDA.
Hmm, interesting. There's a lot to read here, looks like I've got something to keep me busy tonight.
If more work related to this comes up, let me know.
Alright. For now, all of you get some rest, food and drinks are on me tonight. Good work.
By the way, I liked your guys. Do you think I could keep working with them?
Great, thanks. Tell your boys they can stop following me now.
Sure, looks like they respect you. Watch each other's backs out there.
Definitely, you worked well together. I'll tell them to leave you be.
Alright. Goodbye.
(Task) I came because of Mage's PDA. What happened?

I can't seem to tie up all the loose ends, but here's how it could've gone: when you went after Mage0s ass, he was waiting for someone so they could launch coordinated attacks on multiple points at once. But, I still don't know who he was waiting for, he never mentions them.
So what's the problem? Mage is dead, nobody's giving the order now.
Damn, kid, I thought you were like me, someone who could connect two brain cells. If we don't act now, the attacks could still happen at any moment if the other guy decides to give the order himself.
Oh... I get it now. So what do we do?

I don't want to leave the base in a vulnerable state. So, I was thinking that we could give the signal ourselves, and then ambush them before they reach the camp. Sounds good? That way, if any of them slip past us, we'd still have time to warn the base. I already worked something out with Fanatic and Gabriel so they could guard the place while we're gone. What do you say?
Sounds good to me. Give the order.
Let me gear up first. I'll be right back.
Perfect. I'll send the signal and get their positions so we can intercept them. Stay close during the fight, I'm counting on you.
Let's wipe them out.
(Task) That was rough. Are you alright?

I've had worse fights, but that last group was well equipped. Makes me wonder who this other person is, the one who could still give the order without Mage around. Looks like I'll have to keep digging.
If I hear anything, I'll let you know.

Right. Here, it's used, but still in good shape. I don't need it anymore, and I think you're gonna face worse things than a bunch of bandits soon enough. Thanks for helping keep the rookie village safe, kid.
Wow... thanks. I'll put it to good use. See you later.
(Task) Hey, I'm looking for Nimble. That you?
The one and only. Come in, make yourself comfortable, and let's talk business. Viper told me you had something for me.
I've got a case, but I'd rather keep it.
Sure, here.
We can't do businesses that way. Come back when you change your mind.
Alright, see you around.

Interesting, looks like it's sealed with a combination lock... I can try opening it and just then we can negotiate, but it'll take some time. I need a few tools that I don't have right now. Do you think you could go see Xenotech? It's a grumpy bastard who's guarding some old warehouses, past the northern railway tracks. It's a no man's land out there, so if you go, you're going at your own risk.
Yeah, I can go. But what do I tell him?
Come on, Viktor, use your head. Tell him whatever you need to get those tools. Things in the Zone run on favors and connections, real friends are rare out here. Figure something out.
Alright. I'll see what I can do.
(Lie) The technician said he doesn't have any tools to sell, but if I bring him the case, he can open it himself.
Well, that's unfortunate. So what now? When it comes to deals like this, I'd rather open the product myself to make sure it's top-quality merchandise.
I can take it to him to unlock it, while unopened of course, and then bring it back.
...You know what? Fine. Here, take the case back. I'm not interested in it anymore.
Great. See you around.
(Task) Hey Nimble. I brought the tools.
Excellent. Let me finish organizing a few orders first, alright? Might take a couple hours. Once I get it open, I'll send you a message. Come by then and we'll see what was inside.
Sounds good. I'll wait for your message.
(Task) I got your message about the case.

Viktor! Look inside, it was such a surprise. Seems to be a modified weapon meant for Mage, a veteran stalker who's been helping the rookie village since forever. I haven't seen him in days now that I think about it... Anyway, there was a note inside the case talking about all this, but I couldn't make much sense of it. I'll give it to you.
Is the weapon any good?

Yeah, it's good. The pistol's been upgraded with tougher modern parts and... cosmetical work too. Seems like it was painted a bit. Whoever worked on it was surely some kind of bandit engineer or something. So, what do you wanna do with it? I can pay you well for it, I'd love to keep it in stock. But if you wanna keep it, that's fine too.
I want the money.
I'm keeping it.

Sure thing, friend. Here you go. (Nimble hands you a thick roll of cash.) And from now on, I'll cut you better prices. Once you've got more money, come back to check my stock. Pleasure doing business with you.
The pleasure was mine. See you around.

Fair enough, it's a damn good weapon. Here, there were a few boxes of ammo inside too, that's why it was so heavy. Just remember: that gun was meant for someone else, so don't go waving it around in front of every stalker you meet.
Alright. I'll be careful. See you around.
Hello! How can I help you, rookie? If you have any doubts, don't hesitate to ask.
Hey, son. I hope everything is going all right...
(Task) Hi, I need to find a cross-shaped grave, one of those with a gas mask on it. Do you have any idea where can I look for one?
Hey, stalker. I don't think we met before. Did you arrive on the last truck?
Yeah, last night. I woke up recently...

I see... I'm Fanatic. Please, accept this as a warm welcome. There aren't many new stalkers coming to the area anymore, and those of us who are left should help each other out. Don't forget that when you leave the Cordon, okay?
Wow, everyone here is so nice. Thank you so much, Fanatic.

You're welcome, son. Make sure you invest in a good suit first, otherwise you'll get torn apart by dogs or a drunken bandit. \n Regarding the cross... I assume you're looking for someone with honest intentions. I know there's a radioactive hill further north with an unmarked grave there, and nobody goes near it because of the anomalies. I'm sorry, that's all I can tell you. Perhaps other stalkers know more about it. A word of advice: don't ask Sidorovich for information about these things, or he'll probably send you to your death in return.
Okay, I'll see if I can find something.
Good. And before you go, son, remember to come see me if you need anything! The mutants in the Zone won't help you, but the stalkers will. Keep that in mind... May God be with you.
Thanks, see you later.
(Task) Do you have any task? I need some money.

Sure, son. I need four army patches. I have a complex assignment involving them, and I need a good outfit to infiltrate. Could you handle that? I'm paying well for the job, and since you're new, I'd pay you a little more, to give you a hand.
Am I supposed to ask the military for them?
Very funny, son. I can't tell you what to do and what not to do, but I wouldn't recommend getting yourself into trouble when trying to get them, alright?
You can count on it.
(Task) I got the patches. Wasn't easy, but I got them.
I figured as much. It wasn't an easy task, but those usually pay the best. Did you have to deal with any military?
Yeah, I had to fight a few that attacked me.
Yeah. Saw some soldiers patrolling near the village and I took care of them.
No, I just found these patches lying around.
Damn, that's rough... But I'm glad you made it back safe. Here's your reward, and take this too, in case you ever need to patch up a wound.
I see... Well, the stalkers probably would've dealt with them eventually anyway. It's a shame those lives were lost. Here's your reward, son.
Now that's some good luck! I heard deserters usually ditch their suits and patches so they don't attract suspicion. Maybe you stumbled onto one of those cases. Here's your reward, son. Good work.
Thanks for the reward. See you around.
(Task) Hey Fanatic, I'm looking for a guy named Atreo. Do you happen to know him?

Know him? He owes me a LOT of money. A whole damn lot. I spent a while trying to track him down so we could settle things peacefully, and also to help him restore his reputation. You know, helping your fellow man and all that. But he's a lost sheep that took advantage of my trust... He robbed me right under my nose and ran away.
Damn... I understand. So you don't know where he is?

No, but I've been asking around and found someone who claims to know something about Atreo. Go talk to Vovan, he's staying just outside the camp in a container that the stalkers turned into a shelter years ago. I don't really know what he's doing there, but if you can convince him to come back to the base, even better. For his own safety.
Thanks, Fanatic. I owe you one, again.
(Interaction) I found Atreo, and I got your money back.
Wow. Were you able to talk to him? Where is he?
Turns out he was pretending to be Vovan. When I cornered him, he wounded me and fled away from Cordon. I think he headed towards Darkscape.

To Darkscape? Dear God... Poor kid. I don't think he has any idea what kind of hell that place is right now. It breaks my heart. \n Anyway, about the money: thanks a ton. Honestly, I hadn't expected to see it since long time ago. I'll be able to finish my project sooner than planned, and that's a huge relief. I've got a few things I can offer you as a reward. What interests you? I can give you a good small-caliber weapon, a full suit that'll keep you safe from radiation and bullets, or if none of that suits you, just cash. Your choice.
I want the weapon.
Give me the suit.
The money would help more.
Good choice. There's no weapon more reliable and cost-effective around this part of the Zone than a good Bizon. You won't regret it. Come see me again if you need anything.
I've seen you walking around in nothing but that leather jacket for a while, so I hope you get some good use out of that suit, son. Come see me again if you need anything.
Wise choice. Buy yourself something useful, son. Come see me again if you need anything.
Thanks, Fanatic. See you around.
(Interaction) I'm crossing Darkscape to head North. Wanna come with me?
That sounds dangerous, kid. I'd like to go with you and make sure everything goes alright, but I've got a contract with Nimble and a commitment to the village. I can't leave my post.
And do you know anyone who might be interested?
Mmmh... I guess you could talk to Doggo. Do you know him? I heard he's in trouble and needs to get out of Cordon. He asked me for permission to hide out in one of the houses.
I'll try talking to him. Thanks, Fanatic.
(Task) Sidorovich told me that you know where a Modified PKM is.
That old man... Do you need to find it urgently? It's really dangerous, kid. I don't want to send you somewhere you might not come back from.
It's a job. The owner asked me to retrieve it.

I see... Alright. It's on the roof of one of the buildings inside the military base, at the south. Listen carefully: they've got machine guns mounted on damn tripods to shred anyone they see, so you need to head far east towards the barbed-wire fence, staying well out of the soldiers' line of sight. Only once you reach the fence, you can turn south. There's a massive minefield there, so stick as close to the wire as you can without snagging yourself on it. You'll see a fallen tree that tore through the fencing. Cross over it and keep going until you spot a pile of stacked crates, I use those to sneak into the base. Once you cross over, you'll notice a hole in the roof, right above the first window. That's where you'll find the weapon you're looking for, buried under a pile of junk. Be careful not to make any noise while in there, that roof's made of old wood.
Very precise, my friend. Thanks.
No problem, kid. Good luck. And don't forget, a lot of those soldiers are young, just like you. So if possible, avoid violence. Better if nobody dies for no reason.
We'll see. Goodbye.
(Task) I found these military frequencies...

(Fanatic takes the documents and gives them a quick look, with a concerned expression) This isn't good... But it explains a lot. No wonder the military has been sweeping through the Cordon like maniacs. Where did you find this?
Vovan had it. I don't know what he wanted it for, but it looked like it has been collecting dust. Sidorovich sent me to retrieve it.

I see. Then you did the right thing by coming to me. I'll keep it short: Sidorovich cuts deals with the military so they can smuggle goods into the Zone illegally. That includes weapons, money, people, etc. Their relationship is unstable because he promises the military that stalkers won't cause trouble for them, but we both know that doesn't always hold true. Somehow he keeps the village 'safe' by preventing raids from reaching the place, and profits from it in the process. It's a carefully planned business, but any change in the balance puts the villagers' lives at risk. It's not exactly ethical... and this sounds like the trader is plotting something.
So what do we do?

I've infiltrated their base several times. I think we could return these without them noticing. Otherwise, I have a contact inside; a mid-ranking soldier who sometimes brings me medicine... We could meet with him and hand these over so he can return them and avoid a catastrophe. What do you think?
Let's infiltrate the base.
Set up that meeting.
Alright, but we need to do this under the cover of night. Come see me after 2 AM and we'll go.
Alright. See you tonight.
Good, I'll send him a message. I'll arrange everything so we can hold the meeting at night. He definitely won't come alone, so stick with me just in case. Come see me after 2 AM, alright?
(Task) I'm here. How are we infiltrating?

Alright. Here's the plan: I'll escort you to the high ground to the east. From there, I'll keep watch with my binoculars and guide you while providing support. The soldiers let their guard down at night. They take people home and only a few stay behind resting, while two or three patrol the area. It's imperative that we do this without hurting anyone. They can't find out we came and left, otherwise it'll cause more problems. Understood?
Understood, no killing anyone. Let's go.
(Task) I'm here. Where's the meeting?

At the mill to the north, it's not too far. I'll speak with my contact, so pleas you cover me from the rooftop, ok? We can't make a scene. My contact is trustworthy and I don't think he's planning anything suspicious.
Alright, I'll climb onto the roof and cover you. Let's go.
(Task) You wanted to talk?

Yes. I owe you an apology, son. Things didn't turn out the way I expected. I was foolish to believe that you could always deal with these people peacefully. I'm not satisfied with what we accomplished... I also owe you a reward, it's clear you care about protecting the village. That's priceless, and I hope this can compensate you. I've always been fond of this weapon.
Thanks for the weapon, but why aren't you satisfied?

We still have the frequencies. That's a problem. And now another concern has come to mind: my contact, Serdyuk. I'm worried about what happened to him. He's not a bad man, and his well-being matters to me. I think I'll investigate these military PDAs, and if I find anything, I'll call you so we can talk. Can I count on you?
You can count on me. See you around.
(Task) The frequencies are where you asked me to leave them.

Those are good news. Their commander goes in and out of that office all the time. The moment he's around, he'll notice them, I'm sure of it. Once that happens, we'll stop having problems with the intensity of their incursions... That situation was getting out of control.
So, are we heading back to the base then?
Of course, but take this first. It may be a relic, but I have faith you'll give it to good use.
Thanks, Fanatic.
(Interaction) I came as soon as I could. What happened?

I heard you're planning to leave the Cordon, and word has spread about the kind of person you are. The stalkers at the camp put together a collection their appreciation of your achievements during your time in the South.
...A collection? Was this your idea or something?
(Fanatic smiles at your confused expression) Nothing like that. You've done well, Viktor. Here, this is from me.
Thanks, Fanatic.

This is from Tokha, Andrew, and the other rookies. They're the ones who appreciate what you've done for the community the most. They've upgraded a weapon and have given it a name that reminds them of you... I'm sure that if Screw were still with us, he would've joined in too.
This is from the veterans. The ones staying in the last house.
Wow... I don't know what to say...
Ah, I almost forgot. This is from Wolf. To be honest, I was surprised he wanted to participate.
Good luck on your journey. I know you're putting together a great team, so I have faith things will go well for you. Take care.
Thanks for everything.
Hello, stalker. How's everything?
(Interaction) How's it going? Are you an experienced stalker? I had a few questions.
Yeah, I'm Gabriel, it's a pleasure. I can tell you're new. What brings you to the Zone?
(Lie) I'm not really sure yet... What about you?

We all have a reason for being here. The ones who still haven't figured it out, deep down, know exactly what they are doing... As for me, I wanted to shoot a movie in the Zone, but the military confiscated my equipment. Once I realized it, I fell in love with this place, and now I make a living protecting this camp.
So, a movie? Interesting.
Yeah, I still carry the script with me. I'll surely film it someday... Anyway, you said you had some questions?
Yeah, let me think.
(Interaction) Do you know where there's a cross-shaped grave?

Yeah, at the exit from the Bar heading towards the warehouses, to the right, it's an old friend of mine. I haven't been able to go back and leave him flowers because the place is crawling with anomalies and won't let anyone through... I suspect it's him playing tricks from the afterlife... haha.
What about in the Cordon?
I've seen one or two, but I can't remember where right now. Maybe ask Fanatic. The guy is really aware of that kind of stuff.
Got it, thanks a lot.
(Interaction) I'm looking for a stalker named Screw. Do you know where he is?
Yeah, he left the camp a few hours ago. He was heading North. I waved at him, but he didn't wave back this time, which is weird. He's usually a very polite guy...
I see. Thanks.
(Interaction) Hey Gabriel, I'm looking for a stalker named Atreo. Do you know him?

Have you talked to the Mage yet? He shot him a while back! He can probably give you more details. I can only give you one warning: don't trust him. He knocked me out once and broke my gas mask in the process... and it was brand new.
Shit... That sucks.
Yeah, he packs a punch, I'll give him that... Anyway, I'll let you get back to your search, stalker.
Thanks a lot. See ya.
Hey, are you the new guy? I don't recognize you yet.
(Interaction) Hey, I'm looking for a cross-shaped grave with a gas mask on top of it. Do you know where there could be one?
Ahh... No, I haven't really paid attention to those details. I only look for artifacts.
I see. Well, see ya.
(Interaction) So, you're an artifact hunter?
Exactly, and I noticed you're new around here. Is that why you came to this place?
(Lie) Yeah, that's why. I want to hunt for artifacts.
(Tell the truth) No, I came for other reasons. But I'm still interested on that.
That's good news! We'll be colleagues then! Name's Screw, nice to meet you. You can trust anyone who hunts artifacts, it's the most honest way to make a living around here.
I'm Viktor, nice to meet you. Any advice on the whole artifact thing?

Sure. First and foremost: protection. Get yourself a gas mask, any kind. You don't want radiation in your lungs on your first day on the job... \n Another thing! Try to keep some rad-protectors on you. They're pills that let you venture more freely into areas where radiation poisoning is more dangerous. Whenever you're looking for an artifact, you can bet your ass you'll be dealing with that.
Got it. Thanks a lot for the advice. See ya!

Everyone's got their reasons for coming here. It's not a place that welcomes you with open arms. But the weather is usually nice this time of the year. Though if it's hot today, expect a nasty storm tomorrow, haha. \n Anyway, I need to get back to what I was doing. It was a pleasure... Viktor, right? Good luck.
See ya.
(Interaction) I'm looking for a stalker nicknamed Atreo. Do you know him?

Great, another one of Atreo's goons... Let me tell you that he lied, stalker, I don't have anything of his. He was the one that ripped me off. He's had my artifacts for a while now. I don't do dirty business, ask anyone at the base.
I'm not a goon, I'm just looking for him...
Ah, my bad. The whole situation has me on edge.
So he stole some artifacts from you?

Yeah, the guy was desperate for work, and since we've gone on expeditions together before, Fanatic asked me to give him a shot when nobody else trusted him. I handed him a container with 3 artifacts that were supposed to be delivered to Freedom for some businesses of mine, and they never arrived... I had trouble with the faction ever since. I lost them as clients because of him.
Shit, that sucks. I'll keep an ear out in case I hear anything about it.
This happened months ago, so I don't know if he still has them. He's probably sold them by now. But I appreciate it.
No problem. Bye.
You new? Did you grab some energy drinks from the box yet? They're right behind me.
If you don't need anything, get lost. I don't want to talk to anybody.
Okay, okay, take it easy...
Why so angry? Chill out, I just need to ask you something.
I don't give a damn about your questions. I've got my own problems.
What if I gave you a hand with that?

...Maybe you could be of some use. See, these fucking dogs are stalking me. Every night they get a little closer while sniffing around. I hate them, I'm terrified they'll eat me in my sleep or something. On top of that, my arm is wounded and I know they can smell the blood just like sharks do. Did you know that? \n You gotta help me deal with them. They're nearby, down in the tunnel... If you help me out, I'll pay you and answer your questions.
Let's go.
Later. I'm busy right now.
About those questions...

Fanatic sent you, didn't he? I'm not going back to the base, man. I'm really sick and I don't want to infect the others. That's all, some weird and highly contagious Zone disease. Don't even get near me if you don't have a gas mask on.
Relax, I just have a few questions for you.
What, are you a cop or something? (Vovan coughs a bit) Sorry, you had questions... Consider my answer your payment then.
Alright. I'm looking for a stalker named "Atreo". Do you know him?
Yeah, I know him. He's— (Vovan bursts into a coughing fit) UGH, MY CHEST! It's killing me!
Are you really that bad off?

Yeah man, a bloodsucker attacked me the other day and left me in deep shit... It almost drained me completely and ruined my jacket. I need to go see the Medic urgently. He can cure me, but Duty cordoned off the northern exits. Could you go check if it's open? Talk to their commander. If you bring me that info, I'll tell you everything about this Atreo guy...
Alright, I'll be back later... Hang in there, stalker.
What are you doing out here alone?
That's none of your business. Don't ask unless you want a mouthful.
A mouthful of what...?
A mouth-full of deez nuts! HAHAHA!
Alright, enough. I don't want to talk right now. Get the hell out of here.
Fine, fine...
How are you holding up? I came as fast as I could. The Duty guys are taking non-stop hits from Monolith, you still can't head North.
Ugh, you were completely useless after all! GET OUT!
I held up my end of the deal. Tell me what you know about Atreo.
I know nothing about Atreo. Now leave me alone.
So... what happened to your chest again?
Don't ask stupid questions! Just leave!
Tell me what happened again, or I'll rip your head off.
Okay, okay, calm down... I was hiding something in a backpack, at night, and a pseudodog cornered me. The bastard ripped my jacket open and its teeth slashed part of my chest.
Didn't you say a bloodsucker attacked you?
(Vovan goes quiet for a moment) ... Right, yeah, that. I got mixed up... I've got a million things on my mind right now, so just leave me alone.
I talked to Rooster. He told me the truth about you and your wound, you bastard.
What the fuck do you want me to do now?
(Quest 1/7) Tell me where Viper's suit is.
(Quest 2/7) Settle things up with Fanatic. He was really worried about you.
(Quest 4/7) Give back what you stole from Rooster.
(Quest 5/7) What did you do with Screw's artifacts?
(Quest 6/7) Where are the military radio frequencies?

Right, Viper's suit... look, you know the ATP (Vehicle Station)? It's hidden behind an old fridge. Search thoroughly inside the buildings and you'll find it. It's high quality, so don't beat it up nor lose it...

Ugh, Fanatic's money... I don't have it on me, it's hidden at the mill, the place known as the elevator. It's inside a wooden box, under an abandoned Van. Nobody goes around there, it's completely exposed and bandits might shoot at you... It's a great hiding spot.
Rooster's gear... I sold it all. Sidorovich should have all the equipment. Take it up with him...
Those artifacts... I sold them to some bandits coming from the Dark Valley. You'll have to talk to Kolyan about that, he probably has them.

The frequencies... I have them right here in this hideout. I needed them to find safe paths to move around the Zone. But you can check the stash and take them if you want, I think Fanatic is interested in that kind of stuff.
Fine, but some things are still missing.
(Quest 7/7) I need the artifact you found in Nox's stash.
Stalker! I never thought you'd be the one to save me... I owe you my life.
You better start coughing out the information.
Sure, sure, yeah. Artyom's money! I don't have it on me, but I swear I can get it all if you give me two days.
You idiot, give me the artifact you stole from Nox.

Oh, right, that, hehe. You have no idea what you're getting yourself into, stalker. Nox wasn't exactly the type who enjoyed helping others. It's only going to lead you astray. Better let me keep the artifact.
Hand it over.
I'm doing this for your own good. And for the good of the Zone!
What the fuck is wrong with you?
Stalker, we are very busy. Do your business quick, please.
Hello, comrade. What brings you back here?
Hi, there's a wounded stalker who needs to head North for medical treatment. Can he pass through?

Greetings, young man. The answer is NO. As you might have noticed, we are under constant siege by the Monolith. We've also lost radio contact with the North,. But we must hold this position, those were our last orders...
Why does the Monolith want to come to the Cordon?
We don't have access to that information, young man. But I suggest you don't stick around long, this side of the Cordon is dangerous... (Kir goes dead silent) Wait. Did you hear that?
What?
I just heard something behind us... SQUAD! TAKE COVER!
What do you need, Captain?
First of all, thank you for standing as our brother-in-arms. These Monolith bastards are lethal.
The pleasure was mine, sir.

Don't be modest, young man, you're an excellent marksman. Please, accept this as a small token of our appreciation for your help. And if there's anything we can do for you, just let us know. You'll always have a bed here from now on, though we still can't let you pass North, my apologies.
No problem, Captain. I'm looking for someone named "Atreo." I need to see him urgently.

Are you familiar with Rooster? He used to be one of ours, but unfortunately, he left our ranks to join the scientists. I know he's researching an anomaly in the Cordon right now, near the rookie camp. Go see him. He came by asking about Atreo two days ago, too.
Thanks! This information will be very useful.
You're welcome, stalker! Stay safe, and stop by to lend a hand whenever you want.
You too, good luck.
(About the suit for Rookie) Hey, Captain. Good to see you in one piece.
Much appreciated, young man. Glad to see you're healthy as well. To what do I owe the pleasure of having you in my warzone?
I heard you keep some combat suits in reserve. Any chance you could spare one for me?
I appreciate you cutting straight to the chase, every second counts here. But what do you need it for? It seems you are not badly equipped.
(Lie) I need it for myself. The suit I'm wearing is practically in tatters, and I have to travel to some dangerous areas.
(Tell the truth) I need it for Rookie Fedya. We're going on an expedition to some dangerous areas.
Your story doesn't add up, young man. I'm sorry, but I have more important things to worry about right now. Goodbye.
Alright, see ya.
So, it wasn't enough for the Rookie to thin my numbers, now he wants to drain my resources too...
I really need it. I'm worried something might happen to him, and he refuses to wear any suit that isn't Duty gear. I think he's still loyal to the faction.
Alright. But this is a gesture of respect towards you, not the Rookie. And as far as I'm concerned, your debt for helping us in combat is more than settled. Here.
Thank you very much, Captain. Goodbye.
(About the suit for Rookie) I came for the suit thing. What do you know?
I've got a spare suit, man. I usually wear it when I send this one in for maintenance, but it's been a while since that happened. You interested? It's one of the good ones.
Hell yeah. Where is it?
Whoa, take it easy, kid. Nothing's free in the Zone. Even dead men's guns usually come irradiated... I'm gonna need 6 grand. Sound fair?
Yeah, here.
I don't have the money right now. Hold onto it for me.

It's all yours then, kid. It's in the backpack on top of the concrete wall with the barbed wire, right in the corner. To get there, you'll need to climb onto the roof first and walk along the wall from there. Just make sure the others don't see you.
Awesome, thanks.
I'm a bit busy, stalker. What do you need?
Hey! Good to see you around here again. Everything good?
HEY VIKTOR! You have no idea how thrilled I am to have to do extra work.
I'm looking for a stalker, they call him Atreo. Do you happen to know anything about him?

Do I know anything? HA! He tried to steal important machinery I use for work. Why the hell does a stalker want a PSI-wave tracker? Or a low-decay anomalous frequency detector for dismantling artifacts? I highly doubt he wanted to run deep studies on a radioactive anomaly that's already been picked clean by stalkers... The idiot probably planned to sell them, but I taught him a good lesson before he got away... You should've seen him! He ran off squealing hahaha.
What did you do to him?

I lunged at him with my knife and we wrestled on the ground for a bit. He grabbed his own knife without me noticing and tried to stab me, but it went wrong. His knife is mine now, HAHA! Anyway, I stabbed him in the ribs and he went off whimpering... If it wasn't for his nasty blood getting on my visor, I could've tracked him, but I lost sight of him in a flash. Bastard's fast.
So he should be covered in blood? What was he wearing?
He wasn't wearing any protective gear. He was just walking around in his yellow jacket...
...Yellow jacket and covered in blood?
HA! You should see your face. Have you seen him recently? If you find him, take my stuff back. If I get them back, I could finally leave the Cordon.
Alright. I'll let you know then. I'm going to look for him.
(Quest) What were you up to? Need a hand?

Yeah, good timing. Not long ago, someone stole one of the measuring instruments I was supposed to use to study this anomaly. I think I can still get the job done regardless, but I need to go into the anomaly, take measurements, come back out, log them into the device, and repeat that a bunch of times. Honestly, I could do it alone, but with your help, it'd be like 20 times faster since it saves me from doing all the back-and-forth. What do you say? I can pay you with an artifact.
Sounds good. What needs to be done then?
Not right now, sorry.

First of all, take one of these, they're rad-protectors so your balls won't shrink. You're gonna need it. The other one is for when you step out of the anomaly, so you don't end up permanently poisoned... \n Second, I'll hook you up with this chip. I just need you to follow my directions and move around inside the anomaly. I'll track your position and sync it with my scanner. When you hit the exact spots I point out, stomp on the ground with all your might so I can read the results and tell you where to go next. We good? Any questions?
...I think I got it. I THINK.
Perfect. Just be careful not to fall into any anomalies, please. I don't want to send a kid to his death just like that, haha. I couldn't call myself a good scientist if that happened, HA!
I'll be careful. Alright, tell me where to go!
That was dangerous. My head hurts...
Whew, take a seat for a second. Here, you saved me a ton of work. You earned this.
Glad I could help.

Look at you, being all helpful, haha. I like you, man. \n I'll be in the Cordon for a bit longer, and as soon as things quiet down in the North, I should head back to Yantar. In case you don't run into me here, see ya over there! I see a bright future for you, stalker... but make sure you aren't glowing from radiation, or you won't make it very far.
Yeah, yeah, see ya.
Look, I managed to get back what Atreo stole from you.
Awesome! Now that's some good news. Where were they?
He had sold them to Sidorovich...
That old bastard... And I even went to ask him if he knew anything, but he played dumb. Did it cost you a lot to get it all back?
I had to deal with a mutant in exchange.
Sounds exactly like something Sidorovich would do, HA! Well, from what I can see, you're in one piece, so you must know your way around mutants. Anyway, take this for your trouble. Thanks, Viktor!
It's nothing.
Are you coming North with me?
I still have things to take care of in Cordon, Viktor. As soon as I sort out my stuff, LET'S GO! Either way, I need to head back to Yantar in a few weeks.
Alright, I'll find you later.
Are you coming North with me?
Hell yeah! But which way? Duty has the road to the Garbage blocked off, and I wouldn't recommend messing with them.
We're going through the woods, east of the Cordon, but there are bound to be Monolith guys. That's why we're putting a squad together. I have a friend organizing everything at the eastern exit.
Great, count me in. I'll grab my gear and we'll go meet your friend. Sound good?
Yeah, let's go!
(Interaction) How do you get along with Viper?

Turns out we go way back!! Can you believe it? I had no clue, didn't even remember. Apparently, I helped him out a few years ago with a wounded friend. In Duty, before combat training, they used to teach us first aid to help others, and honestly, I'm pretty damn good at it. \n Whoops, got sidetracked. I like Viper, though he's a very serious and cautious guy. He always seems to worry too much about everyone else. I just hope if things go south, he doesn't put others ahead of himself...
I see.
(Interaction) Hey Rooster, what do you think of Rookie?

I love Rookie! I don't know what his deal is, but I have a blast scaring him. Even if I do it 20 times, he still falls for it like it's the first time, HA! Anxiety aside though, he seems like a pretty sad guy. I hope he finds whatever he's looking for in the Zone when we head North.
I see...
(Interaction) Hey Rooster, have you met Doggo yet?

That guy rings a bell, but I can't place where from... Other than that, yeah! We've already had a chat. He gave me some ammo and seems to know a ton about weaponry. Maybe, given the right tools, we could have a new technician at some point.
Interesting, I didn't know that.
(Interaction) How's guard duty going? Any danger?
Nothing I can't handle. But Viktor, I have something really important to tell you...
What's it about?
Pay close attention to what I'm about to do, it's proof of my natural stealth. Don't take your eyes off me, alright?
Got it, I'm watching...
(Quest) Hey, do you happen to need any toolkits?
Pffft, just because I'm a technician you think I need those little toys? No sir, keep them to yourself.
I see... and don't you need help with anything?

Are you hungry for work, stalker? Alright... Look, as you've probably seen, the situation around here isn't favorable, but I promised someone close to me that I'd stay at this base no matter what. And I'm keeping my word for now. The bandits and mercenaries don't shoot at me, but sometimes they force me to fix their gear for free. They've stolen a lot of my tools and I'm slowly going broke. I can barely work on weapons and suits with what I have left.
So you DO need toolkits?

I see you're one of those missing a few cards in his deck... If I had those, THEY'D STEAL THEM. I want any other old tools that nobody looks at with greedy eyes; old hammers, wrenches, whatever. You get me? Look, I'd better give you a list so you don't get lost. Bring me whatever you find and I'll pay you piece by piece. Once I have everything I need, I'll upgrade your gear. How's that sound?
Alright, I'll bring them to you.
(Interaction) About that promise you made...
Good god, I just woke up and you're already snooping around. GOD! WHY DO YOU SEND ME SUCH ANNOYING STALKERS?
I'll just be on my way.

No, come here. Let me tell you. A few years back, us loners organized under the command of the best human being to ever step foot in the Zone: Father Valerian. It all started with him, a mercenary, another stalker, and me. We were the most seasoned guys around, and the best; and good friends too. Though the mercenary was only with us for convenience, but whatever. Valerian went on an expedition too deep into the North and left me in charge, but without his charisma and leadership, things started to fall apart... There used to be around 30 or 40 people at this base. Those were the days.
So Valerian didn't make it?

Nobody knows. There were rumors he died in the Red Forest, but half the Zone is just rumors anyway. I prefer to think that one day he'll come back wanting to round up the stalkers again... Until then, I'm not leaving this place to anyone.
Got it. Let me know if I can help you with anything regarding that.
No, stalker. You've pried too much already. You're making me nostalgic. Why don't you go chase shiny rocks in some radioactive field? Come back when you've done something useful with your life.
(Quest) About the tools...
I can't believe my ears. Did you actually do something useful with your time?
I brought you an axe.
I brought you a hammer.
I brought you a wrench.
I brought you a shovel.
I brought you a sledgehammer.
I brought you a pickaxe.
I brought you a rasp.
I already have everything you asked for, right?
...No, it was nothing.
Perfect, let me fix your suit with an axe... Take a little cash for the trouble, I know it takes a lot out of you.
Finally, a tool I can actually use... Here, some positive reinforcement so you keep moving up in life.
This looks awful, but it's exactly what I need. Here's a tip for your trouble, stalker. Congrats on doing something useful with your time!
I think you need this more than I do if you're looking for work... But here, for your trouble.
Well, I can keep the bandits away with this. Thanks for the effort. I'm sure you got lost on the way, so I really appreciate you actually making it back.
I'd better not say anything. Here, for your trouble... I hope you can afford a doctor to get your head checked or something.
Now this is useful, thanks stalker. I see you finally realized that us technicians actually use these kinds of tools.
Oh, right. Forgot to reward you. Here, kid, a little cash to spend right here on upgrading your gear, now that you can.
Honestly, I'm wrong every time I call you useless. You have a real talent for wasting my time, you know that?
Thanks, I'll probably do that.
(Quest) Hey. I'm looking for Xenotech, the technician. Is that you?
Depends. What do you need?
(Tell the truth) Nimble sent me. I need tools to force open a locked briefcase.
(Lie) The trader sent me. He asked me to look for some special tools to open a locked briefcase.
(Open the briefcase for myself) If I brought a locked briefcase and some money, could you open it?
So that thief Nimble sent another thief to negotiate? Tell him he owes me cash. He pays up first, then we talk. 5000 cash and the tools are his.
Alright, I'll come back with the stuff later.

Sidorovich sent you? Well, look, he didn't give me a heads-up on the PDA, so tell him to shoot me a message first. I don't know you, kid, and I'm not handing over tools to some stranger whose face looks like a thief.
Fine, I'll talk to Sidorovich then. You'll see.
You got money? You don't look like it. That service runs about 2500 cash.
Of course I do. I'll bring it right over, wait for me.
(Quest) I got the money.
Excellent. Just what I needed. Here, tell Nimble to keep 'em, and if he wants anything else, tell him to show his face instead of sending kids to do his dirty work.
Alright, see ya.
(Lie about Sidorovich) Did you get the trader's message?
Of course I got it... Take the tools. When you're done using them, put them back in this leather case, lube it up a bit, and shove it way up your ass, got it?
Perfect. See ya, asshole.
(Open locked box) I have the money.
Let's see it, hand it over. Hmm, looks like an easy job. Give me a minute.
Sure, I'll wait.
Alright, all done. The box had this inside. I don't know what it means, but it's your problem now.
Thanks, see ya.
(Quest) Did you need to talk to me?
Listen, Viktor. I have a delicate matter that I must handle, and from what I hear, it might interest you too.
Tell me, what's it about?

A while ago, a stalker came by asking about a cross-shaped grave, among other crazy questions. He called himself "Atreo". Before giving him any info, I asked him to put a team together and do a little job for me...
And what happened?

I asked them to check out a spot in Cordon since there's supposed to be a bandit stash there.\n He put a team of three stalkers together: Rat, Sentinel, and Ashtray; and they got to work... None of them came back. They're all missing, and I really need that stash. Will you handle this for me? While at it, maybe you can track down this Atreo guy and get some answers. Seems to me like you need them, don't you?
Yeah. I need to find him, I have unfinished business with him.

I don't care if he's alive, dead, if you have to rob him, gouge his eyes out, or whatever. I need my stash. I suspect he has some codes for secret military frequencies: It's a gold mine for me, so I'll pay you well.\n Take the coordinates, check out the place, and don't breathe a word of this to anyone.
Alright. I'll go check out the place.
(Quest) The group was dead. There was no sign of your stash or the codes.
So you came back empty-handed... Look, I NEED to intercept those frequencies, it'll give me a massive tactical advantage over the military's plans. What else did you find out? Did they all die?
Ashtray, Sentinel, and Rat were a total mess. But there was no sign of Atreo...

Don't you find that suspicious? That guy must know things we don't, and he's using that advantage to pull off something big.\n Here's what's gonna happen: we're gonna keep working together, Viktor. I'll keep pulling strings with my contacts to get info, and I expect you to do the same. Talk to any stalkers you know and find out where that guy went, and when you find him, get me the codes for those fucking frequencies. Don't take them to anyone else, got it?
Alright. Let me know if you find out anything new.
Of course I'll let you know. Don't forget that I'm the one helping you. Now get going, I've got things to do.
Later.
(Interaction) I was told you handle the information around here, and I have a few questions...

I don't just handle information, I control who knows what and who doesn't. But I need you to do something for me first. I run on a favor system, so if you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. Otherwise, you gotta pay. But it's written all over your face that you don't have a dime on you, so let's keep it simple with a quick job. Sounds good?
What's it about?

The Zone is crawling with bandits who end up causing me more trouble than they should. They mess with my people, they take cash from my stalkers. Cash that belongs to me! You get where I'm going with this? Take care of any bandit you see, strip whatever you find off them as proof, I don't care if it's a patch or an ear, just bring me PROOF. Only then can we talk as equals.
So... if I bring you bandit patches, you'll help me with whatever I need?
Yeah, I've got the info you need after all: stashes, stalker locations, dark secrets, you name it. I have everything, you can count on that.
Fine, if I get any, I'll bring them to you.
(Interaction) I have some questions...
Did you bring bandit patches? I want at least 7.
Yeah, I have them right here.
No. I haven't got them yet.
Then no deal.
Ok. See ya.
What do you need to know, Stalker?
I need to find a cross-shaped grave with a gas mask on it.
What do you know about the stalker "Hook"?
I'm looking for the artifact hunter "Screw".
Do you know where I can find food?
Is there a stash with medical supplies?
Where can I find a good suit?
I'm looking for a missing modified PKM. What do you know?
Do you know of any interesting stashes?
Changed my mind. Excuse me.

I think I know what you're looking for. Someone else came asking about that recently... Know the train tracks further north? Underneath them, on the west side, there's a tunnel with some anomalies hanging from the ceiling. If you cross it and keep going straight, you'll hit a hill sooner or later. What you're looking for is right there. It's dangerous out there, lots of radiation. Buy some meds before heading up.

The bastard is a role model for the local stalkers. We did some good businesses at first. He was one of those newbies who quickly learned how the Zone worked, and along with some other stalkers, they formed a pretty unique group that frequently ventures north. I could tell you he's among the top 5 expert stalker groups, and they handle sensitive secrets around here. But tracking them down is tricky. Your best bet is to wait for him at the village, since they come back every few months.

I haven't seen him for several days. He was working on a theory that certain artifacts can only be found at night and in dark places, so he asked me about a spot like that here in the Cordon. I told him to check out the railway tunnels. There's one to the east and another to the west, at the edges of the map... Maybe you should take a look around there.

I just sent someone to that exact location, so make sure you get there before they do. Heading south from the rookie camp, a military convoy got ripped to shreds by some mutants a few nights ago. I know they were moving a food container, so check there. Maybe one of the crates still has something left.

It's not much of a stash, but I know stalkers avoid the area due to radiation. There's an old derailed locomotive at the east of the Cordon. If you follow the tracks in that direction, you'll see it. Check the electrical box that's on the roof and the surrounding area.

The info isn't entirely reliable since several people have paid me for the exact same thing. So I don't know if you'll actually find it there... Outside the military base that's further south, just outside the perimeter, there are some crates used for smuggling and slipping things into the black market. It's stuff the military has to hide outside the base whenever a commander shows up to inspect the place. Check there, you'll definitely find something. I recommend going at night so they don't see you. Just cross the wire fence on the east side and slip past undetected.

You're in luck. The information comes straight from our mutual friend Fanatic, so it's reliable. The military recently combed the northern Cordon trying to track down one of their own who went missing, claiming he went crazy and had grotesque visions of ghosts in the Zone. They didn't find their man, but they found a weapon the likes of which you only see once or twice during a stalker's long stay in the Zone: your weapon, the one you're looking for.\n I've been working with Fanatic for a while regarding the military, and he's brought me some pretty interesting information. Go talk to him on my behalf and he'll tell you where is that thing you need. You're welcome.

What a coincidence. I just had an argument with a group of veterans who make runs up north. We shared certain interests, but it seems they woke up on the wrong side of the bed and decided to bite the hand that fed them for so long. You get what I mean, right? I'll give you this key. With this, you should be able to open the locked box that's in the attic of one of the houses in the village. I don't know what's in there, but if they were using it, it's gotta be good.
Got it, thanks for the info.
(Quest) I'm here for Rooster's gear. I know Atreo sold it to you.
So that Vovan guy was actually Atreo, huh? What a liar.
Exactly, that info's on the house. Now I need Rooster's gear.
I'm very busy trying to figure something out, stalker. Too busy, I can't wrap my head around this matter right now... A shame I can't help you.
...What do you need me to do to get your help?

I see we speak the same language after all, glad to hear that. I'm having an issue with a kid who runs errands for me from the Swamp, and I've got orders piling up. The problem? There's a "Monster" in the southern tunnel that leads from the Swamps to the Cordon. If you take care of that, I'm sure I'll have more room in my brain for what you need. Do we have a deal?
What kind of monster are we talking about?
That's for you to find out. Probably just a pissed-off pig hogging the tunnel. Good hunting, stalker! I'll be waiting for you.
I hope you have the stuff ready for when I get back...
(Tell him about the mutant)
Who would've thought? I was right then, just a pissed-off pig... Incredible that this whole mess was over something so stupid.
Yeah, yeah. What about Rooster's gear?

Know the Cordon technician? His name is Xenotech. He's further north, past the railway embankment, in some abandoned hangars that were turned into a base. Go see him, tell him I sent you. I'll let him know you're heading over anyway. He bought the gear yesterday for a personal project I can't give you details on. I'll tell him to give it to you and settle it with me later. Sounds good? And while you're at it, tell him this is purely your own whim. I didn't know it was stolen goods, alright?\n One more thing: that base is usually crawling with drunk bandits, so watch your back.
So the technician is friendly with the bandits then?
No. Things are more complicated than that. You'll have to ask him yourself.
Alright. See ya.
(Quest) I found this PDA on a corpse. It belonged to Screw.

My artifact supply is bound to take a hit... A huge loss, no doubt. But anyway, more importantly, let's talk business. What do you want for the PDA? I can offer you some cash (10,000) or a detector (VELES) that Screw himself had ordered but never picked up.
Give me the cash.
Give me the detector.
All yours, a pleasure doing business with you, stalker. Come back if you find anything that's useful.
Good choice. If you find any artifacts with it, bring 'em to me.
Alright, see you later.
(About tricking Xenotech) I need your help with something.
Hey there, Viktor, right? Tell me what I can do for you, and then we'll discuss a price.
I need to open a box for someone, but Xenotech has the tools. I told him you sent me so he'd hand them over, but he asked me to have you message him first.

Wow, so you didn't hesitate for a second to use my name. I like you, but next time ask me before speaking for me. It's in your best interest to keep me as a friend, newbie...\n As for your little problem, I can help. Count on it, but I want a favor in advance. Bring me bandit patches. About 5 should do it. It'll take me less than a minute to contact Xenotech and make your whole plan work out.
Alright, it won't happen again. I'll bring you the patches right away, wait for me.
(About tricking Xenotech) I brought you the patches.

Now that was fast. Did you have them stashed away in a chest or something? Whatever, doesn't matter. A favor for a favor. I'll tell Xenotech to give you what you need so you can finish your transaction.\n Come see me if you plan on pulling stunts like that again, I think we can help each other out.
Alright. Thanks, Sidorovich.
(Quest) I got the frequencies you were looking for.
This is definitely good news. Where were they? Did Atreo have them?
Yeah. He had them. He was posing as some guy named Vovan to keep a low profile.
Idiot, robbing me right under my nose on my own turf like he'd get away scot-free. Tell me you took care of him at least.
No, he escaped like a rat and I have to track him down... Did you find out anything else about him?

I put together a list of the names and appearances he used. Looks like his real name is Leto; he came to the Zone many years ago, but he's had a run of bad luck. He was up north with some experienced stalkers, but a bug got into his head or something and he's been slowly losing his mind. He started robbing and lying to everyone: stalkers, bandits, even his own friends, nobody was safe. He used other names besides Leto: Yvir, Vovan, Atreo, Máscuto, Prophet, among other weird ones. Always in his yellow jacket, though for a while he wore a closed-cycle breathing suit that he later had to pawn off. People who knew him said he lost his mind after seeing the horrors in the Pripyat underground. But who knows? That's all I've got.
The son of a bitch couldn't handle a few dogs, and yet he was roaming the northern part of the Zone like it was nothing? There's definitely something weird going on.

Before I forget, I have your pay. Tell me what you're interested in: a suit like the ones my associates use (Bar Guard Suit), a very well-balanced helmet (Crafted Helmet), a good shotgun (Fort 500), or a nice stack of cash. What works best for you to track down Leto?
Give me the suit.
Give me the helmet.
Give me the shotgun.
Give me the cash.
Hope you find it useful, Viktor. Remember you've got a good partner in this bunker. If I find out anything else about this name-changer, I'll send a message your way.
Alright, see ya.
How was the hunt?
(Interaction) Why do they call you "Skinner"?
I don't like the nickname, I prefer just "Richard." They call me Skinner because I work with mutant parts, and that means getting your hands dirty. You get me?
So I can bring you whatever I harvest from mutants?
Yeah. Bring me whatever you find and I'll give you some cash for it. Also, if you need to go out hunting, I'm the right guy to get supplies from.
Got it. Thanks.
Ugh. I don't feel so good...
(Interaction) What's the matter?
I haven't stopped throwing up since I got here the other night. I'm constantly dizzy.
Is it your first time in the Zone too? You've gotta be careful with radiation.
Is it that obvious? Yeah... first time. I still don't know if it was a brilliant idea or the worst mistake of my life.
What brought you to the Zone?

Let's just say the Zone has a certain... reputation. I always heard stories. Treasures, artifacts, a different life. But truth be told, I didn't have much to lose out there. A debt here, a problem there... And well, here I am.
I see. We're not so different then.
(Interaction) So, how did you end up in the Zone?

Well... it wasn't easy, that's for sure. I'd heard a lot of stories about the Zone, about its dangers and... its secrets. Back on the Mainland, things weren't going well for me. Debts, problems — you know how it is when the world starts closing in on you. That's when I heard about a couple of guys, supposed ex-military, who claimed to know a "safe" route to cross.
Sounds sketchy. The military smuggled me in on a truck.

Yours sounds more legal than mine... But at the time I had no other choice. I paid them what they asked - more than I really had - and they told me they'd take me to a safe place inside the Zone. The crossing began on a moonless night. We walked in silence, with only their flashlights cutting through the dark.\n At first, everything was going fine, though the air felt... strange; like if nature itself was warning me to turn back. Then, after passing through a dense forest, one of them said it was the end of the road for me. That I was close to a rookie camp and would have to continue on my own.
Let me guess. They didn't keep their end of the deal...

Exactly. I told them that wasn't what we agreed on, but they just left me there, saying they couldn't risk going any further. Before I could argue, they were already gone. \n I pushed on like they told me, but... I didn't know the terrain. The forest was dense, the trees seemed to be watching me, and the strange sounds that started coming from all around didn't help on my nerves. I was armed with nothing but an old 9x18 pistol I'd bought on the Mainland, and trust me, I barely knew how to use it.
Well, if you ever need help, you can always ask. Nobody survives alone out here.

I appreciate that. Maybe I'll take your word on it someday. For now... I'd rather keep watching. Get a feel on how all this works. Though, who knows — maybe next time I'll have something interesting to tell. The Zone has strange ways of catching you off guard. Doesn't it?
Yeah. Take care, Andrei.
(Task) Hey, Sidorovich sent me to pick up some equipment.

Yeah, he just told me. Free piece of advice — don't do business with him. One day you buy something from him and the next he sends some dimwit to fetch what cost you good money, and if you don't want trouble with the guy who pulls all the strings in Cordon, you gotta bow your head and take it.
I'll keep your advice in mind...
Here. I'd honestly recommend finding something better to do. If you work with him regularly, you'll end up dead or sold off to the bandits. Now leave me alone.
Alright, see you around.
Stalker! You shouldn't be here. This place is very dangerous.
Viktor! Good to see you again.
Damn it, Viktor! Don't go sneaking around like that, I didn't hear you coming and you scared the shit out of me. Everything alright?
(Task) Stalker, you got a minute? I'm in a bit of a bind...
Just passing through. What do you need?

I promise I won't take up too much of your time. Here's the situation: I'm new here, one of the newest in Duty. I joined up a month ago and suddenly the whole Monolith mess exploded with them pushing south. I had no time to learn how the Zone works! So my comrades keep pulling pranks on me and laughing at my expense. \n They've hidden my food, my knife, my water, etc. Nothing too serious, really, but yesterday they've gone too far: they hid my main shotgun, the one I use for self-defense, and I can't find it anywhere. Captain Kir gets angry if we abandon our positions, so I haven't been able to search very far either. Would you try to look it up for me? It can't be far, since none of us can leave the outpost at any time.
Sure, I'll look for it.
I'm busy right now, maybe later.

Great! It's good to see decent people around the Zone. By the way, my name's Fedya, but around here they call me "Rookie" — nice to meet you. About my weapon: it's a modified Saiga Shotgun, a mark of Duty veterans. I inherited it from a Sergeant who died in the Garbage and left it to me for my heroic actions; his words. That weapon means a lot to me.
I'm Viktor, nice to meet you. Soon as I find out anything about your weapon, I'll let you know.
Good. Please hurry. There could be a gear inspection with the Captain at any moment and they'll cut my head off if I don't have the weapon.
Will do. See you.
(Task) I found the weapon. It was well hidden.

Damn, I hate those guys. They won't be pulling any more pranks on me now that I've got my weapon back. Here. It's not much, but it's money I've earned with my own hard work. Thanks for helping me, stalker.
Don't mention it. See you around.
Wait! Before you go, I think I can trust you with something else... I need help with something more personal.
Sure, what's going on?

I've been thinking about leaving Duty once things calm down. It's too dangerous and honestly I don't share all their ideals. Although I do respect them! \n The thing is, I don't want to walk away and end up without any group to fall back on, it's not safe out there alone. I used to have a friend here in Cordon when I first arrived. Maybe you know him? They call him Screw, he became a great artifact hunter from what I've heard. But when I tried to reach him I couldn't locate him or find out much about him, and I can't really leave the base. Would you look for him? Any information would help.
Sure, I think I've heard that name. I'll look into it.
Great, thank you so much!
Don't mention it. See you.
(Task) I've found Screw...
Oh no... You're bringing me bad news, aren't you?
(Give PDA) I'm afraid so. I found him dead in the railway tunnel, east of Cordon. He had this PDA on him, and it's got some photos of you in it.
(Hide PDA) Yeah, he was dead in the railway tunnel, east of Cordon. The place was crawling with radiation...

Damn it, Screw... Why does the Zone always take the best ones? Anyway, here, Viktor. Thank you so much for looking for him, and even more for bringing me the PDA. These photos are worth their weight in gold to me... Once I'm done with everything related to Duty, I'll send a message, we can meet up for a drink. I'll pay.
Damn... Screw, what the hell happened to you? Anyway, here, Viktor. Thank you very much.
We'll be in touch then. See you.
My condolences... See you.
(Interaction) I'm leaving Cordon and heading north. You coming with us?
How are you planning to go? You can't get to the Garbage without disobeying Captain Kir... Duty has the exit cordoned off.
We won't be breaking any Duty rules if we go through Darkscape... Captain Kir doesn't need to know.
Clever... Let me grab my things and we'll head out, ok? I'll be right back.
I'll wait for you.
(Interaction) I'm leaving Cordon and heading north. You coming with us?
Man, I'd love to. It's exactly the excuse I need to leave Duty... But I'd want to find my friend first. If I find him in time, maybe he'll join us too!
I'll keep looking for him then.
(Interaction) What do you think of Rooster?
